subject.title: BL-buying-account-10: profile picture upload failure is silently discarded

question: Should the explicit profile-picture upload failure fix be applied inside https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/pull/7100, or should this issue wait for that PR to merge before a narrow bugfix PR updates the new BL spec/test on dev?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but current dev does not yet contain the requested profile-photo BL spec/test target, so automation should not choose the branch sequencing alone.

options.title: Fix inside BL PR
options.body: Apply the endpoint error and the matching BL spec/test changes on the open buying/account PR branch before it lands.

options.title: Fix after BL PR lands
options.body: Keep this issue open until the BL extraction merges, then create a narrow bugfix PR against dev with the code and BL test/spec update.

options.title: Split code first
options.body: Patch the endpoint on dev now and accept a short-lived follow-up for the BL spec/test once the extraction branch lands.

recommendation.title: Fix inside BL PR
recommendation.body: Apply the endpoint error and the matching BL spec/test changes on the open buying/account PR branch before it lands.

likelyOwner.reason: MarcosTerroso owns the open BL branch where the requested spec/test currently live.
